messages:
elena: FYI escalation from AcmeHealth — they hit repeated tool/function-calling failures. Customer says calls return schema validation errors (422) and sometimes the runtime chooses the wrong tool. They reported this started after we deployed the schema-relaxation change yesterday. Attached minimal repro and logs.

jordan: Can you paste the raw request and the exact error? Also what model & runtime (hosted vs dedicated) were they on?

elena: Hosted API, model redwood-2.1, region eu-west-1. Raw request (customer redacted):

```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-2.1",
  "input": "charge subscription",
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "charge_user",
    "arguments": "{\"user_id\": 123, \"amount\": \"100.00\", \"currency\": USD }"
  }
}
```

elena: Note `arguments` is a single string (we accept object) and `currency` is unquoted -> parse error in our schema validator. Customer says they always passed object in their client before; our adapter appears to have started serializing it as a string for some calls.

sam: CI side — our eval suite (toolcall-schema-golden_prompts.test) flaked on master after PR #4123 (schema-relaxation). Re-running locally fails 3 of 120 golden prompts: the tests expect normalized arguments objects but are getting stringified JSON in 3 cases.

ci-bot: Pipeline report: commit 9f4b2ea -> tests/toolcall_schema_suite FAILED (3 regressions). Full logs: https://ci.redwood/run/9f4b2ea/toolcall_schema_suite

kevin: Runtime note: we changed the serializer in runtime v2.3 to try to be more permissive (auto-stringify non-JSON-safe payloads). Might be a bad interaction with tool resolver that prefers fuzzy matches when argument types mismatch. I'll look at serializer patch.

jordan: Also seeing evidence tool resolver picks the wrong tool when arguments are stringified — fuzzy name ranking bumps alternative tool (refund_user) because charge_user signature no longer matches due to type mismatch. That explains wrong tool selection.

elena: Customer logs (excerpt):
```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z ERROR SchemaValidationError: invalid type for field amount, expected number, got string
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z WARN ToolResolver: selected refund_user (score 0.72) over charge_user (score 0.69)
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z INFO RequestLatency: 1.1s total, 850ms model, 250ms resolver
```

sam: Repro steps for eng to reproduce locally (from support):
1) Checkout master at commit 9f4b2ea
2) Start local runtime with serializer flag on: `RUNTIME_SERIALIZER=permissive yarn start`
3) Run curl: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer x" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-2.1","input":"charge subscription","tool_call":{"name":"charge_user","arguments":"{\"user_id\":123,\"amount\":\"100.00\",\"currency\":USD}"}}'
```
4) Observe SchemaValidationError and resolver choosing refund_user.

jordan: Action items: I'll add a guard in resolver to prefer name exact-match over fuzzy when arg types mismatch, pending tests. Kevin: can you revert the serializer change or add a code path that preserves objects for `tool_call.arguments`? Sam: can you pin the three failing golden prompts and add them to a CI backstop so we don't regress silently?

kevin: I can hotfix serializer to avoid stringifying plain objects for `tool_call.arguments` (throwing instead), then we can roll forward. Preparing patch now.

elena: I'll update AcmeHealth with repro and ETA. Also asking them for a minimal client payload if they can share before we push. :pray:

sam: Temporary mitigation for CI: mark the 3 golden prompts as flaky and create a follow-up ticket to extend test coverage for serializer/resolver interactions. Ticket: GH#5128.

jordan: Also adding a regression test to eval harness: assert that `tool_call.arguments` arrives as JSON object (not string) for golden prompts and that resolver picks the exact tool if names match.

elena: Thanks all. Please post PR numbers here so I can include in customer update.

kevin: PR #5140 opened (serializer: avoid stringifying tool_call.arguments).

jordan: PR #5142 opened (resolver: exact-match preference on name when signature mismatch).

sam: CI re-run queued. (link: https://ci.redwood/run/9f4b2ea/5140-5142-rerun)

ci-bot: Re-run completed: tests/toolcall_schema_suite PASSED (regressions resolved).

elena: Customer notified, they confirmed workaround works. Closing escalation after 24h stable check. :white_check_mark:
